# Synthetic Scene Edit Records

This cumulative file contains the evidence-backed Scene edits after direct full-video review of all 100 videos. The original randomized allocation was corrected wherever its target, timing, dependency, or taxonomy was not supported by the source video.

- Global allocation: 100 videos / 300 edit records
- Directly reviewed and finalized: 100 videos / 300 edit records
- Current status: videos 001-100 are directly reviewed and final
- Taxonomy policy: current counts are the semantically verified distribution; the allocation plan preserves both the original quotas and the revised counts
- Temporal policy: ordinary locomotion, camera travel, and instantaneous state changes are not labeled as semantic progress control
- Timing: E1 < 20.0 seconds; E2A/E2B >= 20.0 and < 37.0 seconds; E1-to-E2B <= 15.0 seconds
- Global branch-to-primary Cramer's V: 0.048149

## Reviewed Primary-Type Counts

| Primary type | Count |
|---|---:|
| Motion | 60 |
| Attribute | 75 |
| Spatial | 50 |
| Composition | 50 |
| Camera | 26 |
| Style | 37 |
| Temporal | 2 |
